app.tagline: Take a photo, upload a file or describe what you need.
app.subline: In a minute you see the model, price and production time. No sign-up.
hero.drop: Drop a file here or tap to choose
tiles.broken.hint: Photograph the part, we find or make a replacement.
tiles.idea.hint: Describe it and get a model.
tiles.file.hint: STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP → price and check.
tiles.printer.hint: Calculator and quotes for print shops.
calc.status.failed: Precise calculation failed, the estimate stands.
calc.infill.hint: How much plastic is inside. More = stronger and pricier.
calc.warn.exceeds_typical_bed: The model is bigger than a typical printer. A printer will split or shrink it.
calc.warn.supports_added: The model needs supports; they are included in the price.
calc.warn.not_watertight: The mesh has holes. Usually fine, a printer will fix it.
calc.warn.flipped_normals: Some faces are inverted. A printer will fix it.
calc.cta.make.soon: Sending to printers is coming soon. Save the link for now.
calc.error.read: Could not read the file. Try STL, 3MF or OBJ.
calc.est_only: This material is estimated only; a printer gives the exact price.
footer.promise: We connect you with a printer. No commissions.
account.title: My account
account.role.printer.hint: Calculator with your own prices and quotes for clients.
account.location_hint: We use the postcode to find printers nearby. No exact address needed.
account.role_required.printer: Turn on “I own a printer” in your account first.
account.role_required.designer: Turn on “I can model” in your account first.
printer.title: Printer
printer.welcome: Welcome! Set your prices and materials, it takes two minutes.
printer.checklist.title: Before you send quotes
printer.checklist.pricing: set your hourly and per-gram price
printer.checklist.location: add your postcode so nearby customers find you
printer.calc.title: Calculator
printer.calc.hint: Upload a client file, see your price, send a quote with one button.
printer.calc.lead: STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP → your price from your price list → PDF quote and link.
printer.profile.title: Prices & profile
printer.profile.hint: Five fields and done. The rest is under “More”.
printer.profile.pricing_hint: Price = grams × CZK/g + hours × CZK/h + setup. Customers see the same prices on their models.
printer.f.materials_hint: Optional per-material gram price (otherwise the general one applies).
printer.f.visible: Show my price to customers on their models
printer.quotes.none: No quotes yet. Start in the calculator.
quote.created: Quote created, add the client and check the lines.
quote.sent_link: Quote is sent, share the link with your client.
quote.title: Title / model
quote.send_link: Mark as sent and get the link
quote.send_hint: Sending generates the PDF and the online version with an Accept button.
quote.pdf.title: Quote
quote.pdf.online: Online version with 3D preview and acceptance
quote.pdf.footer: Quote created on matplace.com. Payment and delivery happen directly between printer and client; matplace takes no commission.
quote.accepted_thanks: Thanks! The printer has been notified and will get in touch.
quote.public.footer: This quote was made by a printer on matplace.com. You pay them directly, we take no commission.
quote.mail.subject: Quote :number from :printer
quote.mail.heading: Quote from :printer
quote.mail.intro: Here is quote :number for :total :currency. The PDF is attached; the online version has a 3D preview and an accept button.
quote.mail.footer: Replying to this e-mail goes straight to the printer.
quote.mail.accepted_intro: Your client just accepted quote :number (:client) for :total CZK. Arrange payment and delivery with them.
quote.mail.accepted_footer: matplace only connected you; payment and delivery are between you.
search.placeholder: What do you need? e.g. “Samsung remote battery cover”
search.none: Nothing ready-made found. Upload your own file, or wait for generation and designers.
search.not_image: That is not a photo. Upload a JPG or PNG.
search.daily_limit: You have used today’s :n photo identifications. Try tomorrow or describe the part in words.
search.results_hint: Download the file at the source and upload it above to see the price. Check the licence with the author.
search.range_hint: Range based on the estimated size. The exact price appears once there is a model.
search.designer_soon: Exact model by a designer within 24 h – coming soon
inquiry.title: Inquiry
inquiry.error: Could not send the inquiry. Check the e-mail and postcode.
inquiry.wait_precise: Wait for the exact price, then you can request production.
inquiry.form.title: Make it for me
inquiry.form.hint: We send the model to nearby printers who print this material. They reply with a price, you choose.
inquiry.form.promise: Free, no commission. You arrange and pay the printer directly.
inquiry.pending_hint: We sent an e-mail to :email. Click the link in it and the inquiry goes out to printers.
inquiry.verified: E-mail verified, the inquiry is on its way to printers.
inquiry.no_offers_yet: No offers yet. Printers usually reply within 24 hours; we will e-mail you.
inquiry.accepted_status: Offer accepted. The printer has your contact; agree on payment and handover in the chat.
inquiry.done_hint: Once you have the print, mark the inquiry as done and rate the printer.
inquiry.done_status: Done. Thanks, please rate the printer.
inquiry.promise: matplace only connected you. Payment and handover are between you and the printer; we take no commission.
inquiry.printer_hint: Inquiries matched to your materials, bed size and distance. The price is prefilled from your price list; adjust as you like.
inquiry.none_for_you: No inquiries yet. Check that materials, prices and postcode are filled in.
inquiry.rough_only: Rough estimate only (no precise slice available).
inquiry.accepted_printer: The customer accepted your offer. Contact: :name, :email, :phone. Agree on payment and handover in the chat.
inquiry.offer_note: Message to the customer (colour, timing, pickup…)
inquiry.closed_for_offers: This inquiry no longer accepts offers.
inquiry.sys.offer: The printer sent an offer: :price CZK.
inquiry.sys.accepted: The customer accepted the offer. Agree on payment and handover.
inquiry.sys.lost: The customer chose another offer. Thanks for your time.
inquiry.mail.footer: matplace only connects you. Payment and handover are directly between you, no commission.
inquiry.mail.verify.subject: Confirm your matplace inquiry
inquiry.mail.verify.heading: One more click
inquiry.mail.verify.body: Confirm that the inquiry for :model (:material, :quantity pcs) is yours. Then we send it to printers near :city.
inquiry.mail.new_inquiry.subject: New inquiry: :model (:material, :quantity pcs)
inquiry.mail.new_inquiry.heading: Someone nearby needs :model printed
inquiry.mail.new_inquiry.body: :material, :quantity pcs, from :city (:distance km). Your price list gives :price CZK. Open the inquiry, check the model and send an offer, or decline.
inquiry.mail.new_offer.subject: Offer from :printer: :price CZK
inquiry.mail.new_offer.heading: You have an offer
inquiry.mail.new_offer.body: :printer offers to print :model for :price CZK. Have a look, compare with others and accept the one that suits you.
inquiry.mail.accepted.subject: Customer accepted your offer (:model)
inquiry.mail.accepted.heading: You have a job 🎉
inquiry.mail.accepted.body: :client accepted your :price CZK offer for :model. Agree on payment and handover in the chat.
inquiry.mail.lost.subject: Customer chose another offer (:model)
inquiry.mail.lost.heading: Not this time
inquiry.mail.lost.body: The customer chose another offer for :model. Thanks for the quick reply, the next inquiry will come.
inquiry.mail.cancelled.subject: Inquiry cancelled (:model)
inquiry.mail.cancelled.heading: The customer cancelled the inquiry
inquiry.mail.cancelled.body: The inquiry for :model is no longer valid. Thanks for your offer.
inquiry.mail.msg_customer.subject: New message from :printer
inquiry.mail.msg_customer.heading: The printer wrote to you
inquiry.mail.msg_printer.subject: New message from the customer (:model)
inquiry.mail.msg_printer.heading: The customer wrote to you
search.generating: Creating a rough model, about a minute…
search.gen_done: The model is ready, calculating the price…
search.gen_failed: Could not create the model. Try another photo (one object, plain background) or a description.
search.gen_daily_limit: Today’s limit (:n) is used up. Signed-in users get :m models a day.
search.gen_global_limit: We have generated the maximum number of models today. Please try tomorrow.
search.gen_text_hint: Not what you were looking for? We can create a rough model from the description. The shape is approximate; set the real size.
tools.title: Tools
tools.lead: All free, no sign-up. Every result ends with a price and a printer.
tools.figure.title: Bust or figure from a photo
tools.figure.hint: Upload a photo; a minute later you have a 3D model and the print price.
tools.calc.title: Price from a file
tools.calc.hint: STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP → rotatable model, price, production time.
tools.sign.title: Sign, name tag, keychain
tools.sign.hint: Type the text, pick a shape and font.
tools.relief.title: Relief and lithophane from a photo
tools.relief.hint: A lithophane that lights up against a lamp, or a raised picture for the wall.
figure.lead: A portrait, a pet or a favourite toy as a 3D print. The shape is an artistic impression from one photo, not an exact copy.
figure.unavailable: Model generation is switched off right now. Try later.
figure.photo_tips: One subject, fully in frame, plain background, sharp photo.
figure.consent: The photo shows me, or I have the person’s consent. I agree that our model-generation provider processes the photo.
figure.privacy: We delete the photo as soon as the model is created. Only people with the link see the model; for guests it is deleted after 30 days.
figure.limits: Free: :n model a day without an account, :m with one.
figure.generating: Creating the model, about a minute…
figure.failed: That did not work. Try another photo: one subject, plain background.
figure.rejected: We cannot use this photo. Try another one.
figure.limit: Today’s limit (:n) is used up. With an account you get :m models a day.
figure.global_limit: We have generated the maximum number of models today. Try tomorrow.
sign.lead: Type the text, pick a shape and get a model exact to the millimetre. You see the price at once and can have it printed.
sign.unavailable: The sign generator is not available right now.
sign.submit: Create the model and price it
sign.failed: That did not work. Try a shorter text or another font.
sign.tip: Tip: raised letters can be printed in two colours with a filament change on the last layers.
relief.lead: Upload a photo and see the model and prices right away. We do not keep the photo.
relief.mode.lithophane.hint: The picture appears when you put a light behind it.
relief.mode.relief.hint: Bright areas rise up, a wall decoration.
relief.submit: Create the model and show prices
relief.working: Creating the model, a few seconds…
relief.failed: That did not work. Try another photo.
relief.privacy: The photo is only used to compute the model and is discarded right away. Portraits and high-contrast photos work best.
calc.tip.generated: This model was made by AI from your input. We count with tree supports, which snap off easily after printing.
calc.tip.lithophane: A lithophane is printed standing, solid and in white material. The preview shows how it looks against light.
calc.tip.relief: A relief prints lying flat without supports. A lighter colour in the preview means a higher spot.
calc.tip.sign: The sign prints lying flat without supports. The text can be a different colour by swapping filament for the last layers.
printer.f.speed_hint: times are computed for a fast printer, slower ones get adjusted
printer.f.speed.fast: Fast (Bambu Lab, Prusa CORE One, Creality K1, Anycubic Kobra S1…)
refine.title: Want to change something on the model?
refine.placeholder: e.g. longer handle, no base, more angular shape
refine.hint: AI creates a new model from the original request plus your change. It counts towards the daily limit.
refine.failed: The change did not work. Try describing it differently.
refine.photo_only: A model from a personal photo cannot be changed in words, a likeness cannot be described. Please upload another photo.
printer.f.portfolio_hint: Photos of finished prints. Customers choose by them.
printer.public.cta: Get a price from this printer
printer.public.cta_hint: Upload a model or a photo, prices show right away.
download.title: Download ready for my printer
download.lead: Pick your printer. You get a file with the model placed and the print settings filled in.
download.how: Open the file in OrcaSlicer or Bambu Studio (both free), press "Slice" and print. PrusaSlicer cannot read this file yet.
download.check: We assume a 0.4 mm nozzle. Before printing check that the printer, nozzle and material match yours.
download.too_big: The model does not fit this printer (:bed). Make it smaller with the size slider.
download.no_material: We have no :m settings for this printer, the standard plastic (PLA) will be used.
